\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,shapes.geometric,shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Latex]
  \node[diamond split,draw=purple!70!black,thick,fill=purple!6,
    aspect=1.25,inner xsep=6pt,inner ysep=4pt,
    minimum width=43mm,minimum height=28mm] (energy)
    {$E_k=\frac12mv^2$\nodepart{lower}$E_p=mgh$};

  \draw[-Latex,thick,blue!75!black] (-42mm,0) --
    node[above] {$W$} (energy.west);
  \draw[-Latex,thick,orange!85!black] (energy.east) --
    node[above] {$\Delta E$} ++(42mm,0);
  \draw[-Latex,red!75!black] (energy.lower) -- ++(0,-14mm)
    node[below] {potential state};
  \draw[gray,densely dashed] (energy.south west) -- (energy.north east);
\end{tikzpicture}
